ValidationRule.description: At least one of the 3 Purchasing Criteria fields are required when closing an opp (won or lost)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(StageName) && IsClosed && AND( ISPICKVAL(Purchasing_Criteria_1__c,""), ISPICKVAL(Purchasing_Criteria_2__c,""), ISPICKVAL(Purchasing_Criteria_3__c,""), ISPICKVAL(Purchasing_Criteria_Details_1__c,""), ISPICKVAL(Purchasing_Criteria_Details_2__c,""), ISPICKVAL(Purchasing_Criteria_Details_3__c,""), NOT(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Subsequent_Opportunity"), NOT(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Partner"), NOT(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Organic_Growth"), NOT(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Renewal"), NOT(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Expansion_Upsell"), NOT(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Churn_Contraction_Risk") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in at least one of the three Purchasing Criteria fields and its corresponding Purchasing Criteria Details field.
